newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico fixes '97 farm credits at 33.972 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Mexico fixes '97 farm credits at 33.972 bln pesos.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry said Thursday the federal government will hand out 33.972 billion pesos of farm credits during 1997 through various government lending institutions.
The vast majority of the funds will be in direct credits and a small portion, 179.3 million pesos, will be in risk capital, the ministry said in the statement.

"With the funds, 4.8 million hectares will be sown and 662,600 head of cattle bought," the ministry said. The funds will be handed out through the farm bank Banrural and other agricultural lending bodies.
